verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a broad REST surface in two APIs. The FRAML API covers transactions, consumer and business users, and batch operations. The Management API covers rule templates, rule instances, cases, case statuses and alerts, backed by downloadable OpenAPI specs and official SDKs. There is no stated UI/API parity claim, though, and some actions are documented as Console-only, such as rolling a webhook secret. Many UI features have no API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment, API coverage for rule simulation, workflow builder, SAR/regulatory filing, watchlist screening configuration, risk scoring configuration and webhook/secret management, and independent corroboration.
